source_of_truth: Operator directive: start Plan C — per-evidence-type code extractors to lift the architecture coverage ceiling off low, one evidence-type per slice. First slice = a JavaScript/TS import extractor for the dashboard, because DontPanic's own as-built map currently reports javascript as missing_extractor (the dashboard ships ~39 ES modules with no extractor), pinning the ceiling low. Scope: relative-import ES module graph only; unresolved imports stay visible at low confidence; coverage stops counting javascript as unextracted. No other languages, no TS type analysis, no UI, no reconciler/Python-crawler change.
completion_test: build_view_state emits the dashboard's JS modules as as-built nodes + relative-import edges (contract-stamped; unresolved imports surface as low-confidence endpoints), and the coverage block no longer lists javascript as missing_extractor — it reports the JS extractor's status instead — so a Python+JS repo with all extractors covered is no longer forced to a low confidence ceiling. Extractor is pure + deterministic and entered through the real build_view_state surface.
